svg.title: SOCI lazy loading on Lambda Managed Instances and Fargate
svg.desc: CodeBuild pushes one image to Amazon ECR under two tags, plain and SOCI-indexed. Lambda Managed Instances functions and Fargate tasks each run both, so the only difference between them is how the image is loaded.

text.tspan: Downloads the whole image before the container starts
Starts the container first, then fetches files as they are read
